title: Generated TypeScript public API baseline pilot
objective: Apply the DEC-051 public API convention to @grafting/x6-canvas with a TypeScript-native generated baseline, documentation enforcement, vendor-type isolation, behavioral contracts, and a deterministic Nx api-check target.
validations: The generic checker test suite passes 5/5 cases covering API drift, missing and empty documentation, forbidden vendor modules and unsafe project paths.
The normal x6-canvas api-check matches the committed generated declaration baseline without mutating its hash or timestamp.
x6-canvas typecheck, build and behavior contract test pass, including the frozen public handle and delegation boundary.
Nx x6-canvas check, test and api-check targets pass with cache bypass.
graph-x6 check and test pass after the facade change.
Architecture Studio typecheck and production Vite build pass with 980 transformed modules.
The repository vendor scan finds @antv/x6 only in packages/x6-canvas/src/index.ts and the public baseline contains no vendor-owned or internal helper types.
TypeScript remains pinned at 5.9.3 under Apache-2.0 and pnpm-lock.yaml has no dependency change from this task.
The generated Nx project graph and repository map are current with 13 projects.
The CI workflow and changed JSON files parse successfully; node --check, repository-map validation and git diff --check pass.
The coordination registry and control-plane audit pass after Graph IR regeneration.
risks: The current documentation policy follows declarations exported directly by the package entry point; a future package with complex re-export chains should evaluate API Extractor.
The local default pnpm installation is currently incomplete because an unrelated active Node process locks node_modules; a clean CI install remains the reproducibility authority.
Python still needs a consumed public boundary before receiving the same convention, and C# remains in indefinite standby.
